doc.text: Welcome to our inaugural broadcast of "Myths and Stories News!"
Check in daily for the latest news updates!
And now, for our first story...
doc.headline: Crudfish Cuisine
doc.text: What? They cooked a crudfish and called it a "fish taco"?
A bit barbaric if you ask me, but it's not my place to judge...
Once again, thank you for tuning into "Myths and Stories News!"
